NEGATIVE-RESULT LINKED #latch-study3-agent-gate Latch as of 2026-11-17 SOURCES DISAGREE

A preregistered provenance gate for small-model tool calls cut wrong state-changing actions at every model size, but cost more task success and correct actions than the registered margins allowed, so the verdict was null.
